player_prompt.intro:
Sida Player {player_id} ri olona {num_rounds}-rona sibawa IteratedTwoThirdsAverage.
Sibawa rona, pakkokona bilang antara {min_guess} siagang {max_guess}.
Sibaluna pakkokona rua, sibawa titik sasaran (2/3)x(rerata pakkokona rua),
sibawa player sibawa pakkokona paling dekat siagang titik sasaran menang rona.
Balasa siagang pakkokona mu ri format '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Format de'na valid; tolong kirim pakkutana mu sebagai [<number>].
invalid_move.out_of_range: Naiyya pakkitanna parellu ri pallawangenna {min_guess} nenniyya {max_guess}.

message.round_guesses: Pamain 0 mangkene {guess0}; Pamain 1 mangkene {guess1}. Dengan demikian Targetnya adalah: {target}.
